name: sqlite-table-viewer
displayName: SQLite Viewer & DB Viewer, Database Viewer (Read-Only)
description: SQLite viewer and DB viewer for .db, .sqlite and .sqlite3 files, read-only and free. Shows rows still in the -wal file and reloads live when the app writes. Browse tables, schema, SELECT queries, JSON and BLOB cells, CSV export. Offline.

sqliteTableViewer.maxFileSizeMB.description: The whole database is loaded into memory. Larger files show a message instead of loading.

sqliteTableViewer.copyMaxRows.description: Copy at most this many rows to the clipboard at once.

sqliteTableViewer.exportMaxRows.description: Export at most this many rows to a CSV or JSON file.

sqliteTableViewer.autoReload.markdownDescription: Reload the view when the database file or its `-wal` file changes on disk. The table, sort, filters and scroll position stay. Turn it off with `false` to get a Reload notice instead.

sqliteTableViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used SQLite Table Viewer for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

sqliteTableViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the right end of the viewer's status line. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with SQLite Table Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Open SQLite files read-only, browse tables, run SELECT queries and look inside JSON and BLOB cells.

steps.title: Open a database
steps.description:
Click any .db, .sqlite, .sqlite3, .db3, .s3db, .sl3, .vscdb or .gpkg file. For other names, right-click the file and pick "Open in SQLite Table Viewer".
[Find a database](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.db%22%5D)

steps.title: Sort, filter and read the schema
steps.description: Pick a table on the left. Click a header to sort and type under it to filter. The Schema tab shows columns, keys, foreign keys and the CREATE statement.

media.altText: The orders table filtered to paid orders over 1,000 dollars and sorted by total, next to the list of tables, views, indexes and triggers.

steps.title: Look inside a cell
steps.description:
Double-click a cell or press Enter. JSON shows as a tree, images show as pictures, and float32 BLOBs show as vectors with their size and norm.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22sqliteTableViewer%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
